test_metaestimators_metadata_routing: test the metadata routing for scikit-learn metaestimators including GridSearchCV, OneVsRestClassifier, and CrossValidator splitters
test_unsupported_estimators_get_metadata: test that get_metadata_routing raises NotImplementedError on unsupported metaestimators like AdaBoostClassifier
test_default_request: test that metaestimator metadata routing requests are empty by default and return a MetadataRouter instance
test_error_on_missing_requests_for_sub_e: test that UnsetMetadataPassedError is raised when metadata is passed without explicit routing requests on sub-estimators
test_setting_request_on_sub_estimator_re: test that calling set_fit_request on sub-estimators allows metadata to be routed without raising errors
test_non_consuming_estimator_works: test that non-consuming sub-estimators work without raising routing errors when metadata routing is enabled
test_metadata_is_routed_correctly_to_sco: test that metadata such as sample_weight is correctly routed to underlying scorers in CV estimators
test_metadata_is_routed_correctly_to_spl: test that metadata and groups are correctly routed to underlying CV splitters in cross-validation estimators
test_metadata_routed_to_group_splitter: test that groups are routed correctly when GroupKFold is used within cross_validate on metaestimators
test_registry_copy: test that _Registry instances are not copied during copy and deepcopy operations
